name: settings_get_android_version
intent: Get the Android version this phone is running from Settings
description: Open Settings, navigate to the About device page, scroll to the Android version entry, and report the version shown.
patterns: What Android version is this phone running?
Check the Android version in Settings

steps.intent: Scroll down in Settings until the About device entry is visible
Tap the About device entry to open the device information page
Scroll down on the About device page to reveal the Android version entry
